summary: Frontend-only testing of the newly converted PROFILE page (resources/js/Pages/Profile/Show.vue + reused public/assets/js/custom/profile-show.js) on the preview URL. Covered all 7 requested scenarios: (1) Public profile as GUEST /u/seller -> avatar, 'test satıcı', badge '🏪 Onaylı Satıcı', '@seller', bio fallback text, stats row 4 İLAN / 0 TEKLİF / 0 TAKİPÇİ / 0 TAKİP / 4.3 PUAN, tab bar rendered; Vitrin shows 4 auction cards (price 20.640 ₺, 'AKTİF' badge, title, '16 teklif / 279' meta); switchPTab works for all 3 tabs (Değerlendirmeler -> 4.3 + 5 stars + '3 değerlendirme' + 3 review items; Aktivite -> 'Aktivite bulunamadı' empty state); guest correctly has no follow/edit buttons; ZERO console/page errors. (2) Owner drawer as seller@test.com on /profile: #editToggle visible, click opens #editDrawer and label flips to 'Kapat'; all 4 etabs (Genel/Güvenlik/Gizlilik/Sosyal) switch correctly; GENEL shows name='test satıcı', username='seller' with '@' prefix, phone with '+90' prefix, live #bio_counter (0/300 -> 32/300 while typing), avatar file input; GÜVENLİK 'Değiştir' buttons reveal #email-form and #pass-form (toggleInline), passStrength bars stay grey for weak input and turn rgb(21,94,239) x4 for 'Abcdef12!x', 'Sil' reveals #delete-form; GİZLİLİK has exactly 5 toggles all unchecked which matches DB (all columns NULL for seller); SOSYAL has 4 inputs social[instagram|twitter|youtube|linkedin] with correct prefixes. (3) Profile update: submitting empty 'Ad soyad' reloads and drawer AUTO-REOPENS on Genel with red (rgb(239,68,68)) 'Ad Soyad zorunludur.' + is-invalid on the input; valid submit shows green 'Profil bilgileriniz güncellendi.' inside the reopened Genel panel; changing name to 'test satıcı QA' did update #heroName after reload (then reverted to 'test satıcı'). (4) Password change with wrong current password: drawer reopens on Güvenlik tab and the message 'Mevcut şifreniz hatalı.' IS in the DOM, but it is INVISIBLE because #pass-form stays collapsed (see issue below). Seller password was never changed. (5) Delete modal guard: clicking account-delete-submit with empty password does NOT open delete-modal and adds is-invalid; after entering a password the modal opens; 'Vazgeç' closes it. delete-modal-confirm was never clicked. (6) Follow as buyer@test.com on /u/seller: 'Takip Et' -> POST /follow/2 200 -> 'Takibi Bırak' + TAKİPÇİ 0->1 with no page reload; second click reverts to 'Takip Et' + 1->0. (7) SPA re-entry: 2 round trips (sidebar 'Ana Sayfa' -> back/forward via Inertia 'Profilim' link and browser back) with ZERO pageerrors and NO 'already declared' SyntaxError; after every remount profile-show.js re-init worked: follow AJAX, switchPTab, drawer toggle, switchETab, bioCount, username sanitiser ('SellerABC!!' -> 'sellerabc'), toggleInline and openDeleteModal guard all still functional.

ui_bugs.issue: Validation errors and success flashes for e-mail/password changes are rendered INSIDE the collapsed .pf-inline-form containers (#pass-form, #email-form). window.__profileShowInit only opens #editDrawer and switches to the 'guvenlik' etab; it never calls toggleInline() on the inline form that holds the error/flash, so after submitting a wrong current password the user sees the Güvenlik tab with no visible feedback ('Mevcut şifreniz hatalı.' exists in the DOM but display:none). Same for pf.flash.email_success / password_success. NOTE: identical logic exists in the old resources/views/profile/show.blade.php, so this is NOT a conversion regression, but it does not match the expected behaviour in the test request.

input[name=phone] has the native `required` attribute while the seller's phone is NULL, so clicking 'Kaydet' is blocked by the browser bubble 'Please fill out this field.' and the profile update can never be submitted until a phone is typed - even when the user only wants to change name/bio. Pre-existing (same as Blade line 229) but worth revisiting since the label says 'GSM numarası' without a required asterisk.

issues: When the drawer is open the 'Kapat' button stretches across almost the whole row (pf-btn-edit flex:2) next to a small share icon - looks unbalanced, but matches the old Blade layout so left as-is.

action_items: In public/assets/js/custom/profile-show.js: after resolving targetTab / drawerTab, also open the inline form that contains the first error field or the flash (e.g. currentpassword|password|password_confirmation -> toggleInline('pass-form'), email|confirmemailpassword -> 'email-form', delete_password -> 'delete-form', and open 'pass-form'/'email-form' when pf.flash.password_success/email_success is present) so the user actually sees 'Mevcut şifreniz hatalı.' / success alerts.
Optional: reconsider the native `required` on the GSM field (or mark it required in the label) because it currently blocks all GENEL saves for users with no phone.
critical_code_review_comments: Show.vue is 532 lines with 6 near-identical native POST forms; consider extracting the edit-drawer tabs into child components to stay under the 700-line/DRY guidance as more logic is added.

Owner edit forms rely on inline global onclick handlers (toggleEdit/switchETab/toggleInline/openDeleteModal) from an external script - works, but the guard logic (e.g. auto-opening the inline form on error) should live in one place to avoid Blade/Vue drift.

Interactive elements in the drawer (etab buttons, Kaydet/Sıfırla, name/username/phone/bio inputs, privacy toggles, social inputs, #editToggle, #follow-btn, .pf-ptab) have no data-testid; tests had to rely on ids/classes. Adding data-testid would make future automation robust.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% - 6.5/7 scenarios fully pass; only the password-error visibility part of scenario 4 fails (error present in DOM but hidden in a collapsed inline form)

seed_data_creation: No new data. Temporarily set seller phone=5551112233 and name='test satıcı QA' to exercise validation/persistence; both reverted (phone back to NULL, name back to 'test satıcı'). Buyer follow toggled and untoggled (follower count back to 0). Seller password NOT changed; account NOT deleted.
test_credentials: seller@test.com / password, buyer@test.com / password (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) - both still valid after testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_10: Profile page (public + owner) Inertia conversion is working. Public /u/seller renders fully for guests, all 3 content tabs switch, follow AJAX works without reload, and profile-show.js re-init on SPA remount is clean (0 pageerrors over 2 round trips, no 'already declared' SyntaxError). Selectors: #editToggle, #editDrawer, .pf-etab (Genel/Güvenlik/Gizlilik/Sosyal), #ep-genel|#ep-guvenlik|#ep-gizlilik|#ep-sosyal, .pf-ptab, #pc-vitrin|#pc-degerlendirmeler|#pc-aktivite, #bio_counter, #new_pass + .pf-pass-bars .pf-pbar, data-testid=account-delete-toggle|account-delete-password|account-delete-submit|delete-modal|delete-modal-cancel, #follow-btn, #follower-count. IMPORTANT: seller's phone is NULL and input[name=phone] is `required`, so any GENEL-form submit test must fill the phone first, otherwise the browser blocks the POST. The only open bug is that #pass-form/#email-form stay collapsed when the server returns errors/flash for those forms. 'Unexpected token !' pageerror appears only on /login (sandboxed preview iframe artifact) - none on the profile page; /storage/*.jpg 403s are expected.
rca_of_the_issue: profile-show.js __profileShowInit maps the first error field to an etab via FIELD_TAB_MAP and calls switchETab, but the Güvenlik-tab sub-forms are separate collapsible blocks (.pf-inline-form { display:none }) that are only opened by the user clicking 'Değiştir' (toggleInline). Since the init routine never toggles those blocks, server-side errors/flashes belonging to the e-mail/password/delete forms render into hidden containers and are invisible after the redirect.
